CREATE SCHEMASTORE VIEW rx_counts WITH CONTAINER aprime_views AS
SELECT inn, dept, count(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patients, min(next_fill) AS earliest_next_fill FROM aprime_rx.dispense GROUP BY inn, dept

SELECT p.mrn, p.display_name, d.dept, d.inn, d.product, d.next_fill, c.decision_id, c.reaction
FROM aprime_rx.dispense d JOIN aprime_rx.patient p ON p.patient_id = d.patient_id
JOIN aprime_lab.pt_decision c ON c.substance = d.inn AND c.decision = 'propose'

CREATE LIGHTNING REST TABLE label FROM aprime_openfda REQUEST (
  endpoint "https://api.fda.gov/drug/label.json?search=set_id:%2208a65cf4-7749-4ceb-6895-8f4805e2b01f%22+set_id:%221a7cb212-56e4-4b9d-a73d-bfee7fe4735e%22+set_id:%2227f15fac-7d98-4114-a2ec-92494a91da98%22+set_id:%22adec4fd2-6858-4c99-91d4-531f5f2a2d79%22+set_id:%22c88f33ed-6dfb-4c5e-bc01-d8e36dd97299%22+set_id:%22dc02a23b-3ff9-4441-aa91-8e9e629a7315%22+set_id:%22ee06186f-2aa3-4990-a760-757579d8f77b%22+set_id:%22fda754f6-d0f3-4dce-a17a-927d64f912f7%22&limit=20", method "GET", http_encoding "URLENCODED", response_type "JSON", insecure_ssl "false") HEADER () BODY ()
CACHE TABLE aprime_openfda.label
ASSIGN LIGHTNING DATABASE aprime_openfda TO ROLE 'APRIME_AGENT'
GRANT SELECT ON LIGHTNING DATABASE TABLE aprime_openfda.label TO ROLE 'APRIME_AGENT'

SELECT r.set_id, r.version, r.effective_time, r.openfda.brand_name FROM aprime_openfda.label LATERAL VIEW explode(results) t AS r

SELECT s.product, s.version AS ours, o.version AS openfda_version, o.effective_time, length(o.wc) AS wc, length(o.ar) AS ar, length(o.alltext) AS alltext
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT setid, product, version FROM aprime_lab.spl_section WHERE purpose IN ('hero', 'score') AND (inn = 'sertraline' OR product IN ('Prozac'))) s
JOIN (SELECT r.set_id AS set_id, r.version AS version, r.effective_time AS effective_time, concat_ws(' ', r.warnings_and_cautions) AS wc, concat_ws(' ', r.adverse_reactions) AS ar,
  concat_ws(' ', r.boxed_warning, r.warnings_and_cautions, r.contraindications, r.adverse_reactions, r.information_for_patients, r.spl_medguide, r.use_in_specific_populations, r.recent_major_changes) AS alltext
  FROM aprime_openfda.label LATERAL VIEW explode(results) t AS r) o ON o.set_id = s.setid

SELECT r.set_id, concat_ws(' ', r.dosage_and_administration) AS da, concat_ws(' ', r.indications_and_usage) AS iu FROM aprime_openfda.label LATERAL VIEW explode(results) t AS r WHERE r.set_id IN ('dc02a23b-3ff9-4441-aa91-8e9e629a7315','08a65cf4-7749-4ceb-6895-8f4805e2b01f')
